blocks.text: Fossil record batata hai ke prokaryotes, yani archaea aur bacteria, 3.5 arab (billion) saal pehle bakasrat (abundant) the. Woh irtiqa (evolution) karte rahe aur agle 2 arab saal tak zameen par bilkul akele rahe. Aaj prokaryotes har wahan milte hain jahan zindagi hai. Bacteria pani, hawa, mitti, khoraak aur janwaron aur podon ke jismon mein rehte hain. Tadaad (number) mein yeh tamam eukaryotes se zyada hain, aur sakht tareen mahol (environment) mein bhi zinda reh sakte hain.
Bacteria mein tanawwo (diversity) aur un ki ecology

Margulis aur Schwartz ne tamam prokaryotes ke liye ek mufeed classification system pesh kiya, jo unhen 16 phyla mein baant ta hai. Kitaab domain Bacteria ke aath aham groups bayan karti hai jo neeche hain.
1. Omnibacteria

Sakht, rod-shaped, heterotrophic, Gram-negative bacteria. Bohat se aham pathogens isi group mein hain. Aksar ke paas flagella hote hain, yeh spores nahin banate, aur aam tor par aerobic hote hain. Escherichia coli is ki misal hai; is group mein vibrios bhi shamil hain.
2. Cyanobacteria

Photosynthetic bacteria jinhon ne zameen ki tareekh (history) mein fiza (atmosphere) mein azaad oxygen barhane ka sab se aham kirdar ada kiya. In mein chlorophyll a aur madadgar (accessory) pigments hote hain jaise carotenoids aur neele aur laal phycobilins. Bohat se cyanobacteria apne khaas cells, heterocysts, mein fiza ki nitrogen fix karte hain. Yeh mitti mein mats ki shakal mein aam hain; cyanobacteria wale lichens chattanon (rocks) ki satah par milte hain; aur samandar ki talchhat (sediments) par mats mein cyanobacteria ka ghalba hota hai.

blocks.title: Cyanobacteria dilchasp baatein
blocks.text: Shayad sab se dilchasp haal hi ki yeh daryaft (discovery) hai ke hamare jadeed petroleum ke zakhair (deposits) ka bara hissa gale sare cyanobacteria ke dheron se bana. Aaloda (polluted) pani mein cyanobacteria ki be-tahasha barhotri se rangeen blooms ban sakte hain; in ke rang un ke photosynthetic pigments se aate hain.
3. Mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas

Yeh groups baqi tamam bacteria se is baat mein mukhtalif hain ke in ke paas cell wall nahin hoti. Wall na hone ki wajah se yeh penicillin aur un doosri antibiotics ke khilaf muzahimat (resistance) rakhte hain jo cell wall ki barhotri rok kar kaam karti hain. Kuch mycoplasmas mammals mein bimariyan karte hain, jaise insaan mein kuch qisam ka pneumonia. Spiroplasmas podon ki aham bimariyan karte hain, jaise nariyal (coconut) ki lethal yellowing disease.
4. Spirochaetes

Lambe spirilla jin ki cell wall Gram-negative hoti hai. In ke paas 2 se le kar 100 se zyada flagella ho sakte hain. Treponema aham spirochaetes hain: yeh syphilis karte hain, ek jaan-leva jinsi (sexually) muntaqil hone wali bimari.
5. Pseudomonads

Seedhe ya mure hue Gram-negative rods jin ke ek sire par ek ya kai flagella hote hain. Yeh mitti aur pani mein milte hain aur organic compounds ko aasani se torte hain. Kuch autotrophic hain, lekin bohat se podon ke pathogens hain, aur kuch denitrification mein kirdar ada karte hain. Pseudomonas aeruginosa mitti, pani aur kachi sabziyon mein hota hai; aam tor par be-zarar hai lekin kamzor logon mein sangeen infections kar sakta hai.
6. Actinomycetes

Dhaage jaisi (filamentous) barhotri wale bacteria. Yeh aise spores banate hain jo na-mawafiq halaat bardasht karte hain. Kuch nitrogen fix karte hain aur bohat se phooldar podon ki root nodules mein milte hain. Kuch dental plaque ke zimmedar hain jis mein daanton ka enamel tabah hota hai. Mycobacterium leprae leprosy (koorh) karta hai aur Mycobacterium tuberculosis tuberculosis (TB). Bohat si antibiotics, jaise tetracycline, chloramphenicol, erythromycin aur neomycin, asal mein actinomycetes se hasil hui theen.

blocks.title: Antibiotics ka zariya
blocks.text: Har saal actinomycetes se taqreeban 150 nai antibiotics daryaft ho rahi hain.
7. Nitrogen fix karne wale aerobic bacteria

Maashi (economically) tor par aham Gram-negative bacteria ka group, aksar flagella wale. Azotobacter is ka rukn hai: yeh mitti aur pani mein rehta hai aur fiza ki nitrogen ko nitrates mein badalta hai.
8. Chemosynthetic bacteria

Yeh bacteria nitrogen, sulphur aur iron ke ghair-namiyati (inorganic) compounds ki oxidation se tawanai (energy) hasil karte hain aur us se apni khoraak banate hain. Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter isi group mein hain: yeh nitrogen compounds (NH3) ko oxidise kar ke tawanai lete hain, aur NH3 nitrite aur phir nitrate mein badal jata hai. Is tarah yeh nitrogen cycle mein aham kirdar ada karte hain.

blocks.title: Table parhne ka tareeqa
blocks.text: Kitaab ki table huroof istemal karti hai: Shakal R rods (bacilli), C cocci, S spirilla, M baqaida chains ya guchhe; Harkat F flagella wale, N non-motile, G gliding; Ghiza H heterotrophic, C chemosynthetic, P photosynthetic. Kitaab ki Figure 2.9 mein aath groups ki misalon ke tor par Escherichia coli, Anabaena, Treponema, mycoplasmas, Pseudomonas, Mycobacterium tuberculosis, Azotobacter aur Nitrosomonas ki tasveerein hain.

blocks.prompt: Kaunse group ke paas cell wall nahin hoti, aur is wajah se woh penicillin ke khilaf muzahimat kyun rakhta hai?
blocks.explanation: Mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas ke paas cell wall nahin hoti. Penicillin aur us jaisi antibiotics cell wall ki barhotri rok kar kaam karti hain, to jab wall hi nahin to un ka koi asar nahin hota.

blocks.text: Quick recap

items: Prokaryotes 3.5 arab saal pehle bakasrat the aur 2 arab saal zameen par akele rahe; bacteria ab har wahan hain jahan zindagi hai aur tadaad mein tamam eukaryotes se zyada hain.

Margulis aur Schwartz ne prokaryotes ko 16 phyla mein rakha; kitaab ke aath groups: omnibacteria, cyanobacteria, mycoplasmas aur spiroplasmas, spirochaetes, pseudomonads, actinomycetes, nitrogen fix karne wale aerobes aur chemosynthetic bacteria.

Cyanobacteria ne zameen ki azaad oxygen barhai aur heterocysts mein nitrogen fix karte hain; actinomycetes se bohat si antibiotics mili; Azotobacter, Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter nitrogen cycle chalate hain.
